offline_package.fallback: online bootstrap when platform, ABI, wheel tag, or digest verification fails

python.integrity: SHA-256 tree plus per-wheel tag validation before pip

browsers.integrity: SHA-256 verified archive and safe ZIP extraction
browsers.note: Other platforms download their matching Chrome artifact during online bootstrap.

platforms.macos: use bundled node_modules only when architecture matches; otherwise npm ci
platforms.windows: ignore bundled macOS node_modules and run npm ci
platforms.linux: ignore bundled macOS node_modules and run npm ci
